brief:
Israeli occupation forces bulldozed agricultural land in the village of Kafr Malik east of Ramallah on Saturday evening, Shehab Wire reported. Local sources said troops began extensive leveling operations hours earlier around the Ein Samia spring, uprooting dozens of trees in the area.

The demolition continued a pattern of land seizures in the region as Israeli forces expand control over Palestinian territories.

title: Israeli forces level farmland in Kafr Malik east of Ramallah
